svg.title: Make a Leafy Friend — step 4: Add a friendly face
svg.desc: For the owl, lay two smooth flat pebbles on the leaf face for eyes and add a small leaf beak. Lay twigs flat for legs. Other creatures can use paper eyes or features drawn on the backing. Leave everything loose, or ask a grown-up to help glue leaves onto card; keep the pebble eyes loose.

text.font-family: Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Trebuchet MS, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Everything stays flat on its backing.
